Description of Building Type: Buildings and other structures that present a relatively low risk to human life in the event of collapse, such as agricultural buildings, temporary structures, and small storage buildings of minor importance
Buildings and other structures not classified as Low

Buildings and other structures that, if they were to collapse, would pose a substantial hazard to human life and the public, such as assembly buildings with an occupancy of more than 300 people in one area, elementary or secondary schools with a capacity greater than 250 people, universities or colleges with a capacity greater than 500 people, healthcare facilities with a patient capacity greater than 50 people but without emergency treatment capability, and jails and detention facilities

Buildings and other structures that are essential to public welfare, or facilities required for post-disaster relief, such as hospitals with emergency treatment facilities, police stations, fire stations and emergency vehicle garages, power plants, water treatment plants, water storage tanks, and pumping stations required to maintain high pressure for firefighting, communication centers, disaster relief centers, airports, flight control centers and hangars required for emergency response, national command centers, and buildings and structures for the production, handling, storage, or use of hazardous, flammable, or explosive substances or chemicals
